name: Cal Brickwell
props: two small uniform fired-clay bricks and a short measuring rod
visual: square low body with one long soft lobe, tired offset eyes, straight sealed mouth
personality: Has never met a wall he could not audit.
biography: He tries to rebuild HyperNorm certainty one approved rectangle at a time.
note: FrizzleBob: The wall is correct. The room is missing.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Nell Fairweight
props: tiny chunky balance beam with two shallow pans and one cubical stone weight
visual: tall curved pear, one hard side-eye, pursed off-center lips
personality: Distrusts anything that balances too quickly.
biography: Her building weighs inconvenient cards until a difference can be charged for.
note: FrizzleBob: Fairness is available in three approved sizes.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Perry Sealmark
props: square pale stone seal with one incised bull-like animal silhouette
visual: wide rounded splat, proud upward gaze, broad single-upper-tooth grin
personality: Wants every package to be immediately recognizable.
biography: The Men in Black encourage his useful distinction between sealed and suspicious.
note: FrizzleBob: The seal has passed inspection. Its contents remain theoretical.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Cora Beadline
props: strand of oversized orange-red carnelian clay beads and short hand drill
visual: compact tilted teardrop, one eye wide and one squeezed, lower lip curled inward
personality: Can see a crooked hole from another century.
biography: She makes the approved pattern repeat, then hides one uneven bead for luck.
note: FrizzleBob: Her act of rebellion measures six millimetres.
calls: Nobody look at the third one.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Rafe Drainclear
props: short hooked scoop and a little terracotta pipe bend
visual: wide crooked bean, brows flared up, open complaining mouth with three uneven interior teeth
biography: He clears black censorship goo from the drains and is told that the blockage is a policy.
note: FrizzleBob: The policy has reached the second floor.
calls: The policy is blocking the drain.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Otto Cargo
props: woven parcel with a simple clay tag and chunky rope loop
visual: upright soft oval, sleepy smiling eyes, slack tiny closed smile
personality: Is happy whenever the parcel is someone else's responsibility.
biography: Hunky and Dory promise the shipment belongs here; Otto stamps the feeling of relief.
note: FrizzleBob: The destination was decided after arrival.
calls: The parcel is no longer mine.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.
